purpose: Consolidated market-price evidence for future offline sourcing. Price tiers are market price tiers for the same material + comparable spec/form, not quality grades.
rules: Supplier A/AA/5A/7A labels are seller vocabulary only and are not project quality standards.
Do not merge round-bead and freeform/focal-bead prices.
Do not treat treated, resin, painted, synthetic or identity-ambiguous goods as the low tier of a natural material.
ESTABLISHED_BAND requires multiple comparable same-spec anchors or a clear same-seller tier ladder.
ANCHOR_ONLY means useful market evidence exists but a full low/mid/high band is not yet justified.
IDENTITY_RISK means public listings are too contaminated by ambiguous names/treatments to build a trustworthy natural-material band.
SPECIALIST_MARKET means origin/species/treatment/weight/luster/certificate or other identity variables dominate price enough that a simple 8mm three-tier model is potentially misleading.
Prices are research references, not purchase approvals.

status_definitions.ESTABLISHED_BAND: usable provisional price band exists for the specified form/spec
status_definitions.ANCHOR_ONLY: one or more usable anchors exist; more comparable quotes needed
status_definitions.IDENTITY_RISK: identity/treatment ambiguity must be resolved before price banding
status_definitions.SPECIALIST_MARKET: use identity-first specialist price model rather than ordinary 8mm bead band

research_conclusion.standard_band_materials: Most ordinary quartz/crystal/agate/obsidian/tiger-eye style bead materials can use same-spec low/mid/high price bands, with 8mm round bead as a common baseline where appropriate.
